# Phase 1: Requirements

1. Read the approved baseline in `requirements.md` and the Jira assessment or request.
2. Separate sourced facts from assumptions and open questions; do not invent business rules.
3. Keep scope aligned to the Library Book Management Catalog and document API documentation sync needs.
4. Use [the requirements template](../../templates/requirements-template.md) to structure `requirements.md`.
5. Link requirements to observable acceptance criteria and verification.
6. Report blockers and wait for the SDLC master to present the approval gate.

The phase agent is `.github/agents/sdlc-step-01-requirements.agent.md`.
